owns: Contract and Contract Product Line SLA policy authority
SR-to-CPL classification result and classification history
canonical monthly SLA cohort membership and cohort state
completed SLA/report evidence needed to reproduce historical results
crossing_rules: HLD-05 supplies accepted source facts such as Report Date/status/suspension; SLA never reads raw workbook truth directly.
HLD-04 supplies accepted SR identity/Customer/status facts; SLA classification does not change ticket lifecycle.
HLD-14 supplies canonical temporal arithmetic and immutable-history semantics.
HLD-12 may project SLA results but cannot redefine cohort membership or policy.
Completed report evidence is historical authority and never cleanup authorization.

classification_boundary.contract: owned by exactly one Customer Organization
classification_boundary.contract_product_line: customer-specific association that owns SLA policy
classification_boundary.service_request: at most one current customer-compatible CPL classification
